about: The 64-instance task list of perf-swe32 (the group's proxy evaluation, 2026-11-12): the first 64 SWE-bench Verified instances, test split, dataset order; its first 32 are tasks/swe32-tasks.json exactly (the same ids in the same order). A plan with `tasks: 64` registers these tasks in this order and the agents start them in this order, at most 16 at once, refilled as they finish; every other plan keeps tasks/swe32-tasks.json. The sealed statements are tasks/tasks-pool-64.json (built on tbench with bin/build_tasks.sh, 2026-11-12; its first 32 entries are byte-identical to tasks/tasks-pool.json's). To change the list: edit `instances`, rebuild the statements on tbench (bin/build_tasks.sh <ids>), copy them to tasks/tasks-pool-64.json, run build.py --reuse-bundle and local_validation.ps1. The tbench half does not read this file (the job sends its instances; the deployed manifest names tasks/swe32-tasks.json only).
